text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"A secluded hot spring...!? 
Your hometown sounds absolutely 
enchanting, Daring Tact!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you. It's surrounded by magnificent 
nature, 
and soaking there is wonderfully 
relaxing."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hardly anyone visits, however. 
There are no paved roads, and one must 
hike 
several kilometers along an animal trail 
to reach it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"That far!? 
...You really are amazing, Daring Tact, 
trekking along a trail like that."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, no, it's just... 
the hot spring is truly that wonderful."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Whenever I push myself too hard in 
training and need to unwind, 
I soak in those waters, listening to the 
birds chirping 
and breathing in the fragrant scent of the 
trees."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"When I do, all tension instantly leaves 
my body and mind. 
...For the sake of a moment like that, a 
slightly 
rugged trek is nothing at all."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, how lovely...!  
Fufu, that settles it! Would you be 
willing 
to show me the way there?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Eh...!? 
You would make the journey all the way out 
there?"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Of course! Lounging in an open-air bath 
amidst pristine nature... 
It sounds like a dream come true! 
I'm sure it would be an unforgettable 
experience♪"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"No matter how rough the road may be, I 
don't care. 
I'll definitely make it through!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe... Understood. 
In that case, I will make sure to prepare 
bear bells for the both of us."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, please do! 
And just in case we lose our way, I'll 
need to study up 
on all the ways to find my bearings!"
